facts.fact: Egypt's ICT ministry launched accessibility tools on its official website, including screen-reader compatibility, keyboard navigation, font and contrast changes and an accessibility icon, available on all pages.
facts.system: أدوات الإتاحة (accessibility tools) on the MCIT website

facts.fact: The article says a presidential initiative to strengthen digital accessibility of government websites, implemented by the National Academy of IT for Persons with Disabilities, aims to generalise accessibility standards across government bodies' sites.
facts.system: Presidential initiative on digital accessibility of government websites

systems.system: Presidential initiative on digital accessibility of government websites
systems.owner: National Academy of IT for Persons with Disabilities (MCIT)
